# Norien

**The registry, runtime, and unified data API for AI agents on Robinhood Chain.**
Publish an agent, install the tools it needs, run it locally under a supervisor,
and read normalized market & on-chain data — one API, one CLI, one SDK.

- 🌐 **Site** — [norien.live](https://norien.live)
- 📱 **App** — [app.norien.live](https://app.norien.live)
- 📖 **Docs** — [docs.norien.live](https://docs.norien.live)
- 🔌 **API** — [api.norien.live](https://api.norien.live)

```bash
# Install the CLI
curl -fsSL https://norien.live/install.sh | sh

# Discover, run, and read
norien search trading
norien install trading-agent && norien run trading-agent
curl https://api.norien.live/api/tokens?limit=5
```

**Registry · Runtime · Tools · Unified data API** — free to use.
